trace.question: Which is the most valuable post in 2010? Please give its id and the owner's display name.
trace.evidence: the most valuable post in 2010 refers to MAX(FavoriteCount) where year(CreationDate) = 2010;

attempts.sql:
SELECT Id, OwnerDisplayName
FROM posts
WHERE strftime('%Y', CreaionDate) = '2010'
ORDER BY FavoriteCount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.Id, u.DisplayName AS OwnerDisplayName
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2010'
ORDER BY p.FavoriteCount DESC
LIMIT 1
